_doc: Rival agency personalities (GDD section 13). The rivals are simulated in the abstract, once a month, with their own seeded RNG (RaceDirector): each pursues the milestones in order. Monthly attempt chance = attempt_base * capacity * pace * (crewed_mult on crewed milestones) / difficulty * (1 + elastic * lag) * push, where lag = milestones behind the leader / 3 (max 1.5) and push grows near the end of the milestone's plausible years. An attempt fails with chance fail_base * (1 - reliability) * boldness and costs setback_months; otherwise the milestone is taken and capacity grows (growth_first / growth_later). delay_weeks / crewed_delay_weeks hold a rival back after the earliest plausible year. Capacity comes from rules.json (rivals[].capacity).
